note.role: Generate radar sequences. TemporalRadarSimulator produces moving-target maps and labels, generate_sequences assembles padded batches, and spec_simulator configures generation from a radar specification.
note.details: Defaults: 16 frames spaced 0.5 seconds apart, 64 range bins by 64 velocity bins, 3 metres per range bin, 1 to 5 targets. gen_sequence returns maps (L,N,K), tracks (targets,L,2), initial velocities, accelerations, classes, target reflection strengths and environment values. RADIAL_GEOMETRY uses 512 by 256 bins with 0.2 metres per range bin. Steering matrices are cached.
note.decides: Motion uses constant acceleration and must stay inside the grid. Defaults enable clutter and noise. Target gains span -5 to 10 dB. Classes, windows and averaged looks change maps.

note.role: Train radar models. train reads cached sequences and configuration, fits TemporalDiT or SpatialUNet, and writes checkpoints and logs. The command-line entry reads configs/base.yaml by default.
note.details: AdamW updates model weights with gradient norm capped at 1. Phase 2 adds trajectory loss, phase 3 adds a condition encoder. Validation defaults to seed 4321 with no condition dropout. Checkpoints include optimizer, configuration, progress and optional moving-average weights. last.pt saves every 250 steps by default, best.pt tracks validation improvement, epoch snapshots default to every 10 epochs.
note.decides: Defaults select TemporalDiT, noise prediction, no loss weighting, 0.1 condition dropout and no mixed precision. Configuration controls loss weights, validation, stopping, initialization and moving-average decay.

note.role: Draw target conditions. Training calls these functions to turn target tracks into map channels that tell the model where requested targets belong, then optionally removes conditions for entire sequences.
note.details: render_condition takes tracks (B,M,L,2), target counts and classes, returning (B,L,4,64,64) by default. Three channels represent steady, fluctuating-power and extended targets. The fourth contains ones. render_vehicle_condition uses per-frame presence and returns (B,L,2,512,256) by default. B means batch size, M target slots and L frames.
note.decides: Gaussian width defaults to 1 bin. Overlapping targets combine by maximum. Vehicle velocity distance wraps across map edges. drop_condition zeros every channel and frame with probability p.

note.role: Predict sequence noise. SpatialUNet is the spatial model option built by train.py, using frames as input and output channels and accepting the same timestep and optional condition arguments as TemporalDiT.
note.details: Defaults: 16 frame channels, 64 base feature channels and 256 time-condition values. Two downsampling stages expand feature channels from 64 to 128 to 256, followed by two upsampling stages with saved features. Each stage has two residual blocks. Output matches input shape. Spatial dimensions must divide by 4. Optional conditions must match the time-condition shape.
note.decides: Frames mix through spatial convolutions. Optional conditions add to the timestep representation. Output weights and biases start at zero. Normalization uses the largest dividing group count among 32,16,8,4,2, otherwise 1.

note.role: View radar sequences. Notebook helpers show maps, target tracks, brightness and comparisons, while sequence_grid and sequence_gif save visual files with optional target markers.
note.details: Grid defaults: 4 columns, 110 dots per inch. GIF defaults: 4 frames per second, 500 by 500 pixels, repeating indefinitely. Notebook sequence views default to frames 0,5,10,15. Markers use supplied tracks or detected peaks. Diagnostics show nearby peaks, track differences, range profiles, normalization and clutter correlation. Camera comparisons connect vehicle boxes with radar labels and transmitter copies.
note.decides: Sequence comparisons share colour limits. Real/simulator, row and camera comparisons use separate 5th to 99.5th percentile limits. Peak searches extend 3 bins. Physical cut helpers assume 64 by 64 maps.

note.role: Mark the tests package. This empty file provides a Python package marker for the tests directory.
note.details: The file contains no code, imports, settings or tests.

note.role: Computes training penalties for prediction error, changing frames, and uneven target movement. traj_loss_from_batch combines position and Doppler penalties using target labels and configured weights.
note.details: diffusion_loss averages squared errors, optionally weighted per sample. smooth_loss penalizes differences between consecutive frames. soft_positions estimates target positions in 5 by 5 windows using softmax weights. doppler_centroids estimates Doppler columns from brightness above each window minimum. Movement penalties ignore padded targets using n_targets.
note.decides: Position estimates default to temperature 1.0. Position penalties use second differences, Doppler penalties use first differences. lambda_traj and lambda_doppler scale their contributions.

note.role: Cuts range and Doppler maps into overlapping patches and rebuilds maps from patch predictions. src/sample.py exposes reconstruction choices for comparing generated samples.
note.details: patchify converts (batch, frames, range, Doppler) into (batch, frames, patches, patch pixels). Defaults use 8 by 8 patches with stride 4. A 64 by 64 map produces 225 patches with 64 values each. unpatchify defaults to 64 by 64 output. tile checks geometry and selects a non-overlapping subset.
note.decides: mean averages overlapping predictions. hann blends with positive raised-cosine weights that favor patch centers. tile uses selected patches without blending. Patch size and stride control coverage.

note.role: Defines radar settings and calculates target and background strength relative to noise. src/scene_sim.py reads its RADIal settings, light speed, and window function.
note.details: RADIal settings are 77 GHz, 512 range bins, 256 Doppler bins, 0.2 meters per range bin, 0.1 meters/second per Doppler bin, 5 frames/second, 16 receivers, and 12 transmitters. Target strength is anchored at 13 dB above noise for a 10 dBsm radar cross section at 100 meters. Background strength defaults to 20 dB above noise there.
note.decides: Target power falls with range to the fourth power, background power to the third. Vehicle sampling defaults to 80% cars, 15% trucks, 5% motorcycles. Windowing defaults to Hamming.

note.role: Reads RADIal recordings, vehicle labels, camera images, and range and Doppler power maps. It builds recording splits and frame sequences, and returns background statistics for comparing map sources.
note.details: Reads labels.csv and radar_FFT/fft_NNNNNN.npy. Drops negative-range labels. Maps sum squared magnitudes across receivers and convert to dB. Targets use range divided by 0.2 meters and Doppler modulo 256. Camera boxes scale by 0.5 for 960 by 540 images. range_profile returns median dB per range bin across frames and Doppler columns.
note.decides: Splits default to 70% training, 10% validation, 20% test by sequence count, keeping recordings whole. Sequences default to 16 consecutive frames without overlap. channels selects leading receivers.

note.role: Provides experimental training penalties for matching target motion, target visibility, and detector behavior. It reuses target windows from src/losses.py and keeps these candidates separate from the production objective.
note.details: range_doppler_residual compares range change per second with average Doppler velocity. target_support_loss compares a central 3 by 3 peak with surrounding cells in a 9 by 9 window. soft_cfar_map returns detection probabilities by comparing power with nearby background. cfar_curve_loss matches detection averages, squared values, adjacent frames, and adjacent Doppler cells.
note.decides: Motion defaults: 0.5-second frames, 3-meter range bins, 0.2496006389776358-meter/second Doppler bins, zero velocity at column 32. Contrast caps at 4. Detector comparisons use false-alarm probabilities 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001.

note.role: Generates radar sequences from saved models or the exact easy simulator distribution. Its command-line entry writes generated and validation images, animations, and comparison metrics.
note.details: generate defaults to 50 sampling steps and returns dB maps shaped (requested sequences, configured frames, 64, 64). Trajectory sampling uses configured map dimensions and defaults to 30 steps. generate_easy produces one steady target at 20 dB above noise without clutter or noise. Command defaults generate 8 sequences, render 4 validation sequences, and write samples/metrics.yaml plus PNG and GIF files.
note.decides: Weights follow checkpoint sample.weights, then raw. auto prefers averaged weights when available. Trajectory sampling defaults to averaged weights and guidance 2.0. Seeds fix sampling noise. Reconstruction overrides allow mean, tile, hann.

note.role: Loads simulated or real scene sequences from disk as needed for training. pack_labels converts per-frame vehicle labels into fixed-size position and presence arrays while preserving vehicle identity.
note.details: Caches contain split_x.npy with shape (sequences, frames, 512, 256) in float16 dB, split_labels.pt, and stats.pt. Eight-frame maps occupy 2 MB per sequence. Labels hold 8 vehicle slots. SceneSequenceDataset reads maps through memory mapping, converts each sequence to float32, and returns x, traj, and present. It also loads metadata.
note.decides: Vehicle slots follow stable simulator vehicle identifiers. Vehicles beyond the 8 slots are dropped. Normalization defaults on and subtracts training mean before dividing by training standard deviation.

note.role: Simulates RADIal-sized radar scenes with road structures, vehicles, receiver effects, and noise. SceneSimulator.gen_sequence returns dB frames, moving-vehicle labels, ego speed, and road type. VARIANTS exposes default and fitted scenarios.
note.details: Defaults produce 8 frames of 512 by 256 maps at 5 frames/second. Each vehicle has 5 scatterers. Rendering sums 16 receiver powers and creates 12 transmitter copies at Doppler offsets 0 and 80 through 240 in steps of 16. Scenes include 3,000 ground scatterers. Labels include visible moving vehicles, excluding parked cars.
note.decides: Road types are equally likely. Receiver defaults use a 4-meter high-pass corner and low-pass edge at 93% of maximum range. fitted_scenario loads configs/scene_fitted.json knobs.

note.role: Checks scene radar rendering and moving vehicle labels through SceneSimulator. Tests cover transmitter copies, requested brightness, near range darkness, label counts, and separation between engineer and fitted settings.
note.details: Requires transmitter offsets (0,80,96,112,128,144,160,176,192,208,224,240). A target at 50 m and -3 m/s peaks at range bin 250 and 12 velocity bins. Requested 30 dB brightness must be within 0.5 dB. Near range median must be darker than middle range, with total brightness span below 120 dB.
note.decides: Across 40 seeds, mean moving labels must exceed 0.5 and stay below 1.6 per frame. Engineer settings equal Scenario defaults. Fitted settings must differ.

note.role: Checks TemporalRadarSimulator outputs, target motion, and radar peaks. Explicit starting positions, velocities, and accelerations must produce their requested trajectories or raise ValueError when they leave the grid.
note.details: Requires float32 maps shaped (16,64,64), trajectories (M,16,2), velocity, acceleration, and class arrays (M,), environment (3,), and 1 to 5 targets. Coordinates stay within bins 0 to 63. Peaks stay within 1.5 bins of labels. Range movement stays at most 2 bins per frame.
note.decides: Point target neighbors must be over 20 dB below the peak. Extended target neighbors must be less than 8 dB below. Explicit trajectory tolerance is 0.0001 bins.

note.role: Checks the shared training loop, configuration driven model selection, checkpoints, and conditional model initialization. Builds small temporary caches and verifies learning, resumed steps, validation, plotting files, and scene cache training.
note.details: Tiny runs use 4 training sequences, 2 validation sequences, width 64, 2 blocks, 4 attention heads, batch 2, phase 1, and learning rate 0.0003. Checks last.pt format 2, optimizer storage, best.pt, and condition shape (2,16,4,64,64). Scene training uses 512×256 maps and 2 condition channels.
note.decides: After 150 steps, final ten losses average below 60% of the first ten. Improvement minimum is 0.001. Raw initialization copies trained weights. Added condition weights start at zero.

note.role: Checks that trajectory losses locate targets, reward steady motion, and send gradients back to radar maps. Synthetic bright blobs provide known positions, while padded target slots exercise batch masking.
note.details: Creates maps shaped (1,L,64,64) using brightness 10 and Gaussian exponent divisor 1.5. Eight frame position estimates must stay within 0.5 bins of labels. Constant velocity loss must be below 0.05. Combined position and velocity losses must produce nonzero gradients. Padded batches must yield finite, nonnegative loss.
note.decides: Position lookup uses neighborhood half width 2 and temperature 0.5. Batch loss weights are 0.01 for trajectory consistency and 0.01 for velocity consistency.

note.role: Checks whether trajectory_adherence distinguishes radar returns matching requested tracks from returns elsewhere. Uses simulator sequences and shifted labels to test hit rates and lasting tracks without matching requests.
note.details: For 8 sequences with seed 0, matching labels must yield hit rate above 80%. Labels shifted by 10 bins must yield below 20%. With one steady target, noise, no clutter, and 20 dB signal to noise ratio, matching labels allow at most 0.5 unrequested lasting tracks per sequence.
note.decides: Shifting labels by 20 bins must produce at least 1 unrequested lasting track per sequence. Tests compare matching requests against deliberately displaced requests.

note.role: Checks conversion of target trajectories into model input maps and removal of conditions during training. Covers class channels, ignored padding, presence channels, vehicle visibility, and wrapping along the circular velocity axis.
note.details: Class conditions have shape (1,2,4,64,64). Class 2 peaks at requested bin (20,41) with value 1, leaving other class channels zero. Presence channel is all ones. Vehicle conditions have shape (1,2,2,512,256), drawing only present vehicles. A vehicle at velocity bin 255.5 gives equal brightness at bins 255 and 0.
note.decides: Condition dropout removes entire sequences. Probability 0.5 must remove between 61 and 139 of 200 sequences. Probability 0 preserves all conditions. Padded target brightness stays below 0.000001.

note.role: Checks SpatialUNet output shape, initial output, configuration selection, and use of the shared training loop. Reads archive/ablations_aug/configs/abl_unet2d.yaml and verifies the saved checkpoint identifies the architecture.
note.details: Small forward tests use 4 frames, base_channels 16, and time_dim 32. Input (2,4,16,16) must keep its shape. Initial output must be exactly zero. Configuration tests set model dimension 32. Training uses 4 cached training sequences, 2 validation sequences, batch 2, and writes last.pt after one step.
note.decides: The configuration must select SpatialUNet and retain architecture value unet2d in the checkpoint. The final output starts at zero.

note.role: Checks radar plotting functions against simulator outputs, including frame views, motion, range profiles, brightness, and normalization. Suppresses display calls and closes figures after each test.
note.details: Checks 1 or 4 frame panels, target markers, 4 image panels plus 2 histograms for two scene rows, and 4 motion axes. Peak estimates stay within 1.5 bins. Cut axes use m/s and meters. Normalization uses mean 41.48 and standard deviation 11.07. Unlabelled generated rows receive no target markers.
note.decides: Uses Agg rendering. Second difference axis starts at zero. Correlation values 0 and 0.9 must separate plotted signal by over 0.5. Neighbor gaps exceed 20 dB for point targets, stay below 8 dB for extended targets.

note.role: Configure scene training. Sets data, model, training, and sampling values for a three-epoch scene run, with checkpoint and log destinations.
note.details: Uses data/scene_engineer, eight-frame sequences, 512 range bins, 256 Doppler bins, and four workers. Model uses patch and stride 32, width 384, 12 blocks, six attention heads, and two condition channels. Training uses batch eight, learning rate 0.0001, bf16 precision, and weight averaging decay 0.998. Outputs checkpoints/scene_smoke_C_p32_s16 and logs/scene_smoke_C_p32_s16.log.
note.decides: Uses v-prediction, 1,000 diffusion steps, schedule shift 16, no clean-output clamp, terminal mean, zero physics-loss weights, 10% condition dropout, and 30-step DDIM sampling with raw weights.

note.role: Assign recording splits. Lists which radar recordings belong to training, validation, and testing.
note.details: Assigns 67 recordings to training, nine to validation, and 13 to testing, totaling 89 recordings. Recording names contain timestamps from November 21 and 22, 2020. Every validation recording is from November 22.
note.decides: Fixes membership by whole recording. The file provides explicit lists rather than a random split rule.

note.role: Record training progress. Stores completed and total counts for the tiny scene training data.
note.details: Reports done=8 and n=8, meaning all eight counted items are complete. The text does not identify the item type.

note.role: Record validation progress. Stores completed and total counts for the tiny scene validation data.
note.details: Reports done=2 and n=2, meaning both counted items are complete. The text does not identify the item type.

note.role: Plan radar generation. Proposes building a simulator, cached data pipeline, and diffusion transformer for coherent radar sequences, with tests and staged physics losses.
note.details: Visible steps specify 16 frames of 64×64 range-versus-velocity maps, spaced 0.5 seconds apart. Overlapping 8×8 patches at stride four produce 225 patches per frame. Proposed model has width 256, eight blocks, and eight attention heads. Simulator outputs maps, target paths, initial velocities, accelerations, classes, and environment values for one to five targets.
note.decides: Specifies temporal-only attention, 1,000-step cosine diffusion predicting noise, and loss weights 0.1 for smoothness and 0.01 each for trajectory and Doppler penalties.

note.role: Plan requested targets. Proposes adding target-path condition maps to the existing transformer, training from an unconditional checkpoint, and measuring whether generated peaks follow requests.
note.details: Visible implementation renders four channels: three target classes and an all-ones presence channel. Maps have shape (batch, frames, 4, 64, 64). Input projection gains condition columns initialized to zero. Training loads checkpoints/e3_long_bs32/last.pt, preferring averaged weights. Proposed sampling returns maps in decibels, defaults to 30 steps and guidance strength two.
note.decides: Drops entire conditions for 10% of training sequences. Tests guidance strengths one, two, and three. Requires hit rate within 0.05 of simulator performance and four distribution checks.

note.role: Specify radar sequences. Claims an approved design for synthetic radar generation, staged from an unconditional backbone through physics losses to motion, environment, and class control.
note.details: Specifies 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences with locked training normalization. Each sequence has 16 maps of 64×64 bins and one to five targets. Model uses 225 overlapping patches per frame, width 256, eight blocks, and eight attention heads. Differentiable target-position losses use intensity-weighted positions inside 5×5 windows around known target paths.
note.decides: Locks temporal-only attention, averaged patch overlaps, cosine noise-prediction diffusion, smoothness weight 0.1, trajectory and Doppler weights 0.01, and 10% conditioning dropout. Excludes real-data training.

note.role: Specify target control. Claims target paths and classes should control generated sequences while brightness, clutter, and noise remain generated by the model.
note.details: Uses four condition channels with Gaussian width one bin and maximum combination for overlapping targets. Keeps factorized attention, 12 blocks, and width 384. Proposes 40 epochs, 25,000 steps, batch 32, learning rate 0.0001, and weight averaging decay 0.9999. Measures requested-peak matches within two bins and unrequested tracks lasting at least eight frames.
note.decides: Uses v-prediction, schedule shift four, no clamp or smoothness loss, and 10% dropout. Requires simulator-relative adherence, four distribution checks, and a conditional hit-rate advantage of 0.20.

note.role: Diagnose weak generation. Claims temporal-only attention causes lost bright content and reports that earlier motion scores mostly measured clutter, then proposes a spatial-attention control experiment.
note.details: Generated standard deviation is 0.63 times real data. Original tracking precision is 19.9%. Corrected detection reaches 93.5% precision and 90.7% target recall. Rescored generated versus real values are motion error 2.147 versus 1.358, persistence 0.0589 versus 0.1437, and histogram difference 0.4084 versus 0.0647. These indicate worse motion, persistence, and intensity distribution.
note.decides: Corrected evaluation keeps five peaks and tracks lasting half the sequence. Spatial-attention controls use 12,500 training steps. Generated standard deviation above 0.85 would confirm the proposed diagnosis.

note.role: Reopen generation diagnosis. Reports failed spatial-attention controls and proposes ordered pipeline checks and training comparisons before resuming physics losses or conditioning.
note.details: Generated normalized standard deviations are 0.6554 for temporal attention, 0.7043 for factorized depth five, and 0.6999 for factorized depth six, versus 1.0043 for held-out data. Neither control clears 0.85. Planned checks cover noise-step errors, target versus background errors, analytical denoisers, no smoothness, no overlap, averaged weights, and a convolutional model.
note.decides: Fixes seed 2026, 12,500 training steps, and 50-step sampling with seed one. Recovery requires standard deviation above 0.85 without worse mean or histogram difference.

note.role: Compare prediction objectives. Claims failures concentrate at diffusion steps 600 onward and preregisters two objective changes while holding the baseline training recipe fixed.
note.details: Compares v-prediction with noise prediction weighted by min(SNR,5)/SNR, where SNR is signal-to-noise ratio. Each arm uses training seeds 2026, 2027, and 2028, 12,500 steps, batch 16, and learning rate 0.0001. Baseline generated standard deviation is 0.655, target tracks per sequence 1.75, and histogram difference 0.380.
note.decides: A fix requires three-seed mean standard deviation above 0.85 and at least 1.75 target tracks per sequence. Smaller-than-noise-floor differences do not count as results.

note.role: Fix experiment queue. Records a user-approved finite queue covering objective changes, existing checkpoint evaluation, conditional combinations, and smoothness weights.
note.details: Cancels a proposed 50,000-step retrain because Phase 1 already trained for 97,500 steps over 78 epochs. Plans scoring snapshots from epochs 10, 30, 50, 70, and best. Smoothness sweep uses weights 0.03 and 0.3. Baseline weight 0.1 produces standard deviation 0.655 and 1.75 target tracks per sequence.
note.decides: Track growth above 0.22 flags insufficient training budgets. Combinations must beat both parents with histogram difference at most 0.60. Queue extensions require user approval.

note.role: Locate missing brightness. Records denoising accuracy, sampling comparisons and training snapshots for checkpoints/phase1_wandb, alongside real data from data/cache.
note.details: Best checkpoint: epoch 63, training step 78,750. Real standard deviation is 1.0028 versus 0.6505 to 0.7207 for generated samples. Real 99.9th percentile is 3.9249 versus 2.0223 to 2.1546 generated. Clean-data reconstruction mean squared error rises from 0.0007 at noise step 10 to 862,251.875 at step 999.
note.decides: Uses 64 real sequences, 16 generated samples and 8 ancestral samples. Compares DDIM sampling at 50, 100 and 250 steps with 1,000-step ancestral sampling.

note.role: Check detected tracks. Records how often detected peaks and track starts match true targets, then compares bright regions in real and generated frames.
note.details: Across 32 real sequences containing 109 targets, 1,898 of 4,096 peaks match targets (46.34%). Only 289 of 1,452 tracks start on targets (19.9%). Bright pixels occupy 18.17% of real frames versus 5.44% generated. Real bright regions average 17.36 pixels versus 4.83 generated, with 46.23 versus 47.89 regions per frame.
note.decides: Uses checkpoints/phase1_wandb/best.pt, data/cache, 32 sequences and target-matching tolerance 2.0. Configured output is samples/diag_track_validity.json.

note.role: Compare output limits. Records brightness, frame changes and straight-line measurements for factorized and temporal variants using mean or tile reduction.
note.details: All 12 settings record zero sequences meeting the straight-line check. With mean reduction, limits of 8 and no limit give identical recorded results. Factorized tile median peak brightness rises from 93.39 dB with limit 4 to 102.08 dB with limit 8. Temporal tile rises from 96.54 to 105.01 dB.
note.decides: Uses 16 samples, seed 1, 50 DDIM sampling steps and terminal_x0 mean. Tests output limits 4, 8 and off with mean or tile reduction.

note.role: Measure sample variety. Compares generated and validation samples with their nearest training examples and records variation in path features.
note.details: Of 256 generated paths, 254 are distinct. Median nearest-training path distance is 0.34054 generated versus 0.33802 validation. Median pixel distance is 156.18 versus 151.54, a generated-to-validation ratio of 1.03061. Reports standard deviations for path features r0, dr, d0 and dd.
note.decides: Uses checkpoints/e0_standard_bs32/last.pt, 256 samples, 50 DDIM sampling steps and EMA weights, an average of training weights over time.

note.role: Compare sampling lengths. Records how sampling method, step count and patch reduction affect outputs from checkpoints/e0_fact_s0/epoch_0010.pt.
note.details: Only mean reduction with 1,000 DDIM steps records a sequence meeting the straight-line check: 1 of 16. Every other setting records none. Mean-reduction standard deviation is 0.549 at 50 DDIM steps versus 2.410 with ancestral sampling. Tile-reduction median peak prominence falls from 2.52 dB at 50 DDIM steps to zero with ancestral sampling.
note.decides: Uses 16 samples, seed 1 and terminal_x0 mean. Compares mean and tile reduction with 50, 250 or 1,000 DDIM steps and 1,000 ancestral steps.

note.role: Compare early models. Records real-data scores and three-seed comparisons for factorized and temporal checkpoints at training step 12,500, each using mean or tile reduction.
note.details: Each seed uses 32 samples. Averaged straight-line fractions are 1.04% for factorized mean, 3.13% for factorized tile and zero for both temporal settings, versus 100% real. Averaged median peak prominence spans 1.88 to 3.65 dB versus 22.03 dB real. Recorded marginal_l1 distances span 0.3015 to 0.4871 versus a real-to-real baseline of 0.0641.
note.decides: Uses epoch_0010.pt checkpoints, seeds 1 to 3, 50 DDIM sampling steps and terminal_x0 mean. Compares mean and tile reduction.

note.role: Score standard training. Records real-data comparisons for checkpoints/e0_standard_bs32/last.pt at training step 62,500, using current training weights and averaged training weights.
note.details: Across three seeds, current weights with 50 DDIM steps are marked works false. Current weights with 250 steps and averaged weights with 50 steps are marked true. Their marginal_l1 distances are 0.11057, 0.08352 and 0.07904 respectively, versus 0.06410 real-to-real. Straight-line fractions are 92.71%, 92.71% and 94.79%, versus 100% real. The supplied text cuts off the averaged-weight 250-step results.
note.decides: Uses data/cache_easy, 20,000 training sequences, 16-frame sequences, batch 32 and 100 epochs. Sets patch and stride 8, factorized attention, schedule_shift 4, output limits off.

note.role: Repeat sampling checks. Records additional seed comparisons for checkpoints/e3_standard_bs32/last.pt at training step 62,625 against the same real-data baseline.
note.details: Across seeds 4 to 9, current weights with 20 DDIM steps pass all recorded checks. Mean persistence is 0.10947 versus 0.14367 real, and marginal_l1 is 0.12135 versus 0.06467 real-to-real. Current weights with 30 steps fail persistence, averaging 0.10403, despite passing the other checks. The supplied averaged-weight results are incomplete.
note.decides: Uses data/cache, factorized attention, 100 training epochs and batch 32. Visible comparisons use current weights with 20 or 30 steps and averaged weights with 20 steps.

note.role: Score full attention. Records sampling checks for checkpoints/e3_full_bs32/last.pt at training step 62,500, with the model configured to use full attention.
note.details: Across six seeds, current weights with 30 and 50 DDIM steps both fail persistence while passing the other checks. Mean persistence is 0.06882 and 0.05753 respectively, versus 0.14367 real. Tracks per sequence average 26.93 and 29.22 versus 23.66 real. Marginal_l1 distances are 0.12005 and 0.09668 versus 0.06467 real-to-real. Supplied averaged-weight results are incomplete.
note.decides: Sets full attention, patch and stride 8, width 384, depth 12 and 6 heads. Uses 100 epochs, batch 32, schedule_shift 4 and output limits off.

note.role: Score longer training. Records sampling checks for checkpoints/e3_long_bs32/last.pt at training step 112,625 after a configured 180 training epochs.
note.details: Across six seeds, current weights with 30 and 50 DDIM steps pass all recorded checks. Mean persistence is 0.12957 and 0.11583 versus 0.14367 real. Target tracks per sequence average 3.323 and 3.177 versus 3.094 real. Marginal_l1 distances are 0.11905 and 0.10674 versus 0.06467 real-to-real. Supplied averaged-weight results are incomplete.
note.decides: Sets 180 training epochs, factorized attention, batch 32 and learning rate 0.0001. Uses schedule_shift 4, output limits off and terminal_x0 model.

note.role: Score standard sampling. Records real-data comparisons for checkpoints/e3_standard_bs32/last.pt at training step 62,625 using current and averaged training weights.
note.details: Across three seeds, current weights with 50 or 250 DDIM steps and averaged weights with 50 steps fail persistence while passing the other checks. Persistence averages 0.08782, 0.07894 and 0.09594 respectively, versus 0.14367 real. Marginal_l1 distances are 0.05961, 0.03447 and 0.04693 versus 0.06467 real-to-real. The supplied averaged-weight 250-step summary is incomplete.
note.decides: Uses data/cache, 100 training epochs, factorized attention and batch 32. Compares current and averaged training weights with 50 and 250 DDIM sampling steps.

note.role: Compare shorter sampling. Records sampling checks at smaller step counts for checkpoints/e3_standard_bs32/last.pt at training step 62,625.
note.details: Across three seeds, current weights with 10 DDIM steps fail standard-deviation and marginal_l1 checks. Current weights with 20 or 30 steps fail persistence only. Their persistence averages 0.09649 and 0.09663 versus 0.14367 real. Marginal_l1 falls from 0.22211 at 10 steps to 0.12433 at 20 and 0.08768 at 30. Supplied averaged-weight results are incomplete.
note.decides: Visible current-weight comparisons use 10, 20 and 30 DDIM steps. Training uses factorized attention, 100 epochs, schedule_shift 4, output limits off and terminal_x0 model.

note.role: Compare brightness limits. Records a completed comparison of output limits and overlapping-patch blending for checkpoints/phase1_wandb/epoch_0010.pt, including brightness, grid boundaries and track scores.
note.details: Generates 32 samples per setting with 50 DDIM steps. Mean blending gives boundary-to-interior difference ratios of 1.118 to 1.282 versus 0.999 real. Hann blending, which weights patch positions, gives 0.947 and 0.984 but marginal_l1 distances of 0.69972 and 0.79209 versus 0.06467 real-to-real. Complete visible settings take 6.09 to 6.15 seconds each. The final setting is truncated.
note.decides: Pairs initial noise with seed 1. Tests mean blending at limits ±4, ±6 and ±8, and Hann blending at ±6 and ±8. Smoothness weight is 0.1.

note.role: Records a completed comparison of mean and Hann patch combination using checkpoints/phase1_wandb/epoch_0070.pt. It measures generated value distributions, patch boundary differences and track scores against real sequences.
note.details: Each method generates 32 sequences with 50 DDIM sampling steps and shared starting noise seed 1. Mean versus Hann: normalized mean -0.353 versus -0.732, compared with real -0.007. Boundary-to-interior difference ratio is 1.099 versus 0.941, compared with real 0.999. Marginal L1 distribution difference is 0.393 versus 0.755, compared with real-versus-real 0.065.
note.decides: Uses raw epoch 70 weights, 8-pixel patches, stride 4, reconstructed-value limits [-4,4], noise prediction, no loss weighting and smoothing strength 0.1.

note.role: Test measured continuity. This note registers and reports whether shuffling measured RADIal background detections changes three-frame paths enough to justify temporal background modeling.
note.details: The test uses 246 non-overlapping 16-frame windows from 111 runs. At detection occupancy 0.001, median ordered-to-permuted path ratios are 1.00 for one-cell movement and 1.18 for four-cell movement. Only 39% and 68% of windows exceed one. Both medians fall below 1.2, so the note drops the premise.
note.decides: Mask eight range bins around vehicles. Use 20 permutations. Premise requires both medians at least 1.5 and 75% of windows above one. Both below 1.2 drops it.

A generalized Pareto tail fit does not consistently improve empirical thresholds. Explicit target_count requests produce counts one through five exactly, with maximum kinematic residual 0.000015. A measured-data residual model was not trained.
note.decides: target_count accepts one count or a count per sequence, restricted to one through five. Omitting it retains empirical count sampling. Synthetic-only evidence cannot establish measured-data fidelity.

note.details: The model uses factorized spatial and temporal attention, 384-wide representations, 12 blocks and averaged weights. Initial 50-step and 250-step samples fail persistence, the fraction of tracks lasting at least 13 of 16 frames. On six fresh seeds, averaged weights with 30 steps yield spread 0.947, L1 0.074, 3.27 target tracks per sequence and persistence 0.121. All checks pass.
note.decides: Require spread within 0.1 of real, L1 at most 0.15, target count within 15% and persistence within 25%. Prefer 30 sampling steps for balanced margins.

note.details: At diffusion level 999, cumulative signal weight is 0.0000000024, amplifying prediction errors 20,291 times. Replacing the first clean estimate with zero changes no-smoothness mean from 0.84 to 0.03 and spread from 1.286 to 0.787. Full scoring still finds only 0.75 to 0.78 target tracks per sequence without smoothness, versus real 3.09.
note.decides: terminal_x0="mean" sets the clean estimate to zero where cumulative signal weight is below 0.000001. Tests keep checkpoints and noise fixed. The verdict is partial.

note.role: Compare joint attention. This note tests attention connecting every spatial and temporal token together and rejects it as a replacement for the factorized model.
note.details: The run trains 100 epochs to 62,500 steps and scores six seeds with 32 sequences each. Joint attention has 32.6 million parameters versus factorized attention's 45 million. Averaged weights with 30 steps yield persistence 0.080 versus factorized 0.121 and real 0.144. Other checks pass. Validation loss is 0.388 versus factorized 0.382, also worse.
note.decides: Replace factorized only if averaged 30-step sampling passes with persistence at least 0.121, or averaged 50-step sampling passes all checks. Neither condition holds.

note.role: Extend full-data training. This note resumes the passing factorized model for 80 more epochs and reports broader success across sampling settings.
note.details: Training resumes model, averaged weights and optimizer from step 62,625, reaching 112,625. All four raw-or-averaged, 30-or-50-step arms pass mean checks. Averaged 30-step sampling gives spread 0.940, L1 0.084, 3.25 target tracks per sequence and persistence 0.124. Its six seed persistences span 0.111 to 0.145, all above the 0.108 limit. It replaces e3_standard.
note.decides: Keep the four existing pass bands. Use averaged weights with 30 DDIM steps because every tested seed clears persistence. Averaged 50-step sampling misses that limit twice.

note.role: Test detector augmentation. This note reports a small-data conditional generator, its copying check and a target-class detector experiment after basic detection proved saturated.
note.details: The generator trains from scratch on 2,000 sequences and creates 8,000 synthetic sequences. Basic brightness detection already reaches AP 0.94. Class-detector mean AP rises from 0.665 with real data to 0.705 with augmentation, exceeding the 0.018 seed-range bar. Full real training reaches 0.760. The generator's training-to-held-out distance ratio is 0.72, meeting the copying rule.
note.decides: GENERATOR_ONLY=1 pauses basic detection. Class augmentation helps when gain exceeds both arms' seed ranges and the task has headroom. Copying is flagged below a 0.8 distance ratio.

note.role: Follow requested paths. This note registers and reports a transformer trained to generate targets along supplied trajectories, giving generated sequences exact requested labels.
note.details: Training adds four conditioning channels, three class blobs plus presence, to e3_long and runs 25,000 steps with 0.1 condition dropout. On 192 held-out requests, guidance 1 gives hit rate 0.973 versus simulator 0.976, unrequested lasting tracks 0.29 versus 0.33 and persistence 0.139 versus real 0.144. All checks pass. Unconditional hit rate is 0.013. Requested-class appearance is unmeasured.
note.decides: Choose guidance from one, two or three using separate validation requests and seeds. Hits must lie within two bins. Require simulator-relative hits, no extra lasting tracks and four distribution checks.

note.role: Plan measured transfer. This evolving design note compares simulator augmentation with a pretrained, fine-tuned transformer and records measured RADIal geometry, simulator fitting and recording-level splits.
note.details: RADIal arrays contain 512 range bins, 256 Doppler bins and 16 receive channels. Range spacing is 0.2 m. radar_D_mps stores bin indices, and radar_P_db stores linear power. note.role: Explain sequence generation. This document claims radSeq generates complete 16-frame radar sequences by learning how each local map region changes over time.
note.details: It describes 64-by-64 frames split into overlapping eight-by-eight patches with stride four. Tokens include patch values, spatial position and frame number. Attention connects the same patch location across frames. Training predicts added Gaussian noise and penalizes abrupt frame changes. Generation uses about 50 DDIM steps from 1,000 training noise levels.
note.decides: The described model uses temporal-only attention, overlapping patches, noise prediction and temporal smoothness. Later phases add motion losses and scene control.

note.role: Explain connected simulation. This document claims radSeq extends RDDiffusion's independent radar images into sequences with shared target motion and evolving clutter.
note.details: Outputs are 16-frame sequences of 64-by-64 log-magnitude maps in dB. Targets follow r(t)=r0+v0*t+0.5*a*t² and v(t)=v0+a*t. Types are steady point, frame-varying Swerling-1 and three-scatterer extended targets. Labels include trajectories, motion, class, count, measured signal-to-clutter-plus-noise ratio and clutter correlation. Matching Doppler labels to the steering matrix avoids an approximately one-bin shift.
note.decides: Reject trajectories leaving the grid. Sample initial motion once per sequence. Evolve clutter using first-order autoregression, where correlation controls persistence, instead of drawing independent frames.

Gaussian labels peak at rounded target bins with sigma one bin. Both networks use encoder and decoder paths with skip connections. Head bias starts at -2.19, approximately 0.1 probability.

Learned positions and timestep conditions guide blocks. load_unconditional_weights copies checkpoint weights and zeros added condition-input columns.

Hit rate counts requested target-frame pairs with a nearby peak. Unwanted tracks count lasting tracks near requested targets in fewer than half their frames.

note.role: Detect above background. ca_cfar_2d estimates background around each signal cell and returns a same-shaped map containing ones at detections.
note.details: The square window side is 2 times (num_train plus num_guard) plus one. The centre and guard square are excluded from the training cells. Noise is their mean. A comment reports filtering improved validation precision from 19.9% to 96.0%, leaving 3.09 tracks per sequence versus 3.41 true targets.

note.role: Traces how each generation step affects the final radar sample and compares it with restoration of real validation sequences. Reads checkpoint configurations and raw model weights, then writes measurements to experiments/dit_64/results/diag_ddim_trace.json by default.

No measured results are included.
note.decides: Uses raw weights and evenly spaced integer timesteps. mean_x0_below defaults to 0, disabling replacement with zero. Builds diffusion without configured schedule_shift or terminal_x0.

note.role: Measures one-step restoration accuracy separately near targets and in background clutter using the same real sequences and noise for each checkpoint. Reads validation shards and stats.pt, then progressively writes experiments/dit_64/results/diag_denoising_by_timestep.json.
note.details: Defaults to 32 sequences, 11 timesteps from 0 to 950, batch four, and noise seed 2026. Compares the temporal baseline with two factorized controls. build_region_masks accepts trajectories shaped (batch, targets, frames, 2). PairMoments reports errors, spread, bias, and correlation. target_frame_metrics reports peak precision, target recall, and brightness contrast. Records checkpoint hashes. No results are supplied.
note.decides: Uses 5×5 target windows, excludes 9×9 guards from clutter, clamps reconstruction to ±4, detects at 12 dB above median, allows five peaks, matches within two bins, assumes noise prediction.

note.role: Checks diffusion formulas and sampling on CPU using exact predictors for known distributions, without loading a trained model. Writes experiments/dit_64/results/diag_diffusion_sanity.json and exits successfully only when every check passes.
note.details: run_sanity defaults to 16,384 samples, 1,000 diffusion steps, 50 sampling steps, and seed 20260815. GaussianOracle targets mean 0.25 and standard deviation 0.5. TwoPointOracle targets equal probability at −2 and +2. Checks schedule endpoints, noisy-data moments, clean-data recovery, and generated distributions. Recovery uses float64, sampling float32. No measured results are included.
note.decides: Pass limits: moment errors five standard errors, recovery error 1e−10, Gaussian mean error 0.04 and spread error 7%, two-point support error 0.0001, balance error 0.03, spread error 1%.

note.role: Score requested trajectories. This script compares a trajectory-conditioned diffusion transformer (DiT), simulator maps and an unconditional model, then writes scores and optionally appends a verdict or saves a picture.
note.details: Defaults: 32 sequences per seed, guidance strengths 1, 2 and 3, 30 sampling steps and averaged training weights (EMA). Guidance uses validation sequences 0-95 with seeds 1-3. Final scoring uses sequences 96-287 with seeds 4-9. Two fixed groups of 32 validation sequences provide the real-data reference.
note.decides: Choose passing guidance first, then highest hit rate. Require simulator hit rate minus 0.05, no extra lasting tracks, four distribution checks and unconditional hit rate 0.20 lower.

note.role: Check easy-data training. This script samples an E0 checkpoint using its saved diffusion settings, compares generated maps with validation maps and writes scores, an optional picture and an optional verdict.
note.details: Defaults: 32 sequences per seed, seeds 1-3 and 50 or 250 sampling steps. Tests raw weights and EMA weights when available. Samples have shape (32, configured sequence length, 64, 64). Uses e0_metrics and averages six reported measures across seeds. Default output is experiments/dit_64/results/e0_standard_scores.json.
note.decides: An arm works when standard deviation differs from real by at most 0.1, histogram difference is at most 0.2, peak prominence reaches 15 dB and 90% follow lines.

note.role: Measure easy target sequences. This script scores named checkpoints on E0, described as one steady target without clutter or noise, and supplies e0_metrics to the standard E0 scorer.
note.details: e0_metrics accepts (batch, frames, range bins, Doppler bins) dB maps. Measures normalized mean, standard deviation, frame differences, dominant peaks and straight-line errors. Peak prominence compares against pixels over four bins away along either axis. Histogram uses 100 bins from -5 to 5. Defaults: 32 sequences, 50 sampling steps, seeds 1-3, data/cache_easy.
note.decides: Uses raw weights and defaults terminal_x0 to mean. A sequence follows a line only when both range and Doppler root-mean-square errors are below one bin.

note.role: Check full-data generation. This script samples a checkpoint using its saved diffusion settings and compares it with held-out maps. Its checks function also supplies the four distribution checks used by score_conditional.py.
note.details: Defaults: 32 sequences per seed, seeds 1-3 and 50 or 250 sampling steps. Tests raw weights and available EMA weights. Splits 64 validation sequences into two reference groups. Reports normalized mean and standard deviation, histogram difference, target and total track counts, persistence and velocity consistency. Writes JSON and optional pictures or notes.
note.decides: Pass requires standard deviation within 0.1 of real, histogram difference at most 0.15, target tracks within 15% of real and persistence within 25% of real.

note.role: Find radar grid scales. This script reads RADIal vehicle labels and radar arrays, locates the strongest map pixel and prints how pixel positions relate to labelled range and Doppler values.

Sums squared magnitudes over 16 receiving channels, reducing (512, 256, 16) arrays to (512, 256) power maps. Defaults to 40 single-vehicle frames ranked by radar_P_db. Prints 15 examples, correlations, fitted slopes, offsets and reciprocal slopes.
note.decides: Uses the global maximum in each selected frame. Fits a line only when absolute correlation exceeds 0.9. Command-line frame count overrides the default of 40.

note.role: Measure real radar maps. This script checks labelled vehicle locations and prints background, clutter and range statistics that the simulator should reproduce.

Grid checks default to 60 frames with 5-by-5 neighborhoods. Scene statistics use 40 frames, Doppler columns 8:248 as background and five range bands covering 0-102.4 metres.
