note.decides: Selects factorized attention and depth 6. Smoothness weight is 0.1. Training seed is 2026 and data seed is 1234. Sampling weights are unspecified.

note.role: Train the phase 1 baseline. This configuration sets up the longer baseline run with online Weights & Biases tracking and early stopping.
note.details: Uses data/cache with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences of 16 frames at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Allows 150 epochs, batch size 16, learning rate 0.0001, and 1,000 diffusion timesteps. Saves to checkpoints/phase1_wandb. Tracking project is radSeq, run phase1-full-seed2026. Sampling uses 50 steps.
note.decides: Early stopping starts after 40 epochs, with patience 15 and minimum improvement 0.0005. Smoothness weight is 0.1. Phase is 1 and training seed is 2026.

note.role: Train with motion losses. This configuration claims to add trajectory and Doppler losses to phase 1 at the full reference budget.
note.details: Uses data/cache with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences, 16 frames each at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Runs 70 epochs, described as 87,500 steps, with batch size 16 and learning rate 0.0001. Saves to checkpoints/phase2_full and logs/phase2_full.log. Samples raw weights in 50 steps.
note.decides: Phase is 2. Smoothness weight is 0.1, trajectory and Doppler weights are 0.01 each. Uses 1,000 diffusion timesteps and training seed 2026.

note.role: Train conditioned sequences. This configuration claims to train from scratch with motion, class, and environment inputs, dropping conditions to support guided sampling.
note.details: Uses data/cache with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences, 16 frames each at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Runs 70 epochs with batch size 16, learning rate 0.0001, and 1,000 diffusion timesteps. Saves to checkpoints/phase3_full. Samples raw weights in 50 steps.
note.decides: Phase is 3 and condition dropout is 0.1. Smoothness weight is 0.1, trajectory and Doppler weights are 0.01 each. Training seed is 2026.

note.role: Recheck phase 1 results. This script validates detected tracks against target labels, compares old and corrected metrics, and writes exit checks for the best baseline checkpoint.
note.details: Defaults use checkpoints/phase1_wandb/best.pt, data/cache, 32 sequences per comparison side, 50 sampling steps, and noise seed 1. Samples have shape (32, configured sequence length, 64, 64), then regain the cached mean and scale. Detector validation reports track precision and target recall. Output defaults to archive/ablations_aug/results/phase1_rescore.json.
note.decides: Compares 8 peaks without filtering against 5 peaks with minimum track length 8. Matching uses median distance at most 2. Persistence difference must be at most 0.2.

note.role: Record patch overlap results. This result file compares the baseline and non-overlapping patches after equal training budgets, measuring brightness, patch boundaries, and detected tracks.
note.details: Each model generated 32 sequences in 50 sampling steps after 12,500 training steps. Removing overlap raised normalized brightness standard deviation from 0.6554 to 0.7440, versus real 1.0043. Boundary-to-interior differences rose from 1.1182 to 1.5810, versus real 0.9991. Target tracks fell from 1.5938 to 0.6875 per sequence, versus real 3.0938. Sampling took 2.06 versus 6.41 seconds.
note.decides: Compares stride 8 against stride 4 with patch size 8, raw weights, epoch 10 checkpoints, and shared initial noise seed 1.

note.role: Record individual change results. This result file compares removing smoothness, using averaged weights, and using a spatial U-Net against the baseline.
note.details: Each arm generated 32 sequences in 50 sampling steps after 12,500 training steps. Normalized brightness standard deviation was 0.6554 baseline, 1.2854 without smoothness, 0.7134 EMA-run raw, 0.7172 averaged, and 0.6737 U-Net, versus real 1.0043. Target tracks per sequence were respectively 1.5938, 0.3438, 1.5313, 1.6875, and 0.4688, versus real 3.0938.
note.decides: Uses shared initial noise seed 1 and epoch 10 checkpoints. Separately scores raw and averaged weights from the same EMA checkpoint, which records 12,500 averaging updates.

note.role: Record spatial attention results. This result file reports whether either factorized-attention control restored brightness spread enough to confirm the proposed diagnosis.
note.details: All models reached epoch 10 and 12,500 training steps. Brightness standard deviation was 0.6554 for the 9.83-million-parameter baseline, 0.7043 for the 8.58-million-parameter five-layer control, and 0.6999 for the 10.22-million-parameter six-layer control, versus real 1.0043. Neither control exceeded 0.85, so diagnosis_confirmed and d5_confirms_not_capacity are false.
note.decides: Confirmation requires generated normalized standard deviation strictly above 0.85 in either control. The five-layer control specifically tests whether additional model capacity explains recovery.

note.role: Record corrected phase 1 scores. This result file measures detector accuracy and scores the best baseline checkpoint using both old and corrected track settings.
note.details: Uses 32 generated sequences and 50 sampling steps from epoch 63, step 78,750. Corrected detection raises track precision from 16.17% to 93.47%, with recall falling from 100% to 90.73%. Generated persistence is 0.0589 versus real 0.1437. Their 0.0847 difference passes the 0.2 limit. Velocity consistency is finite at 2.1471. Generated target tracks average 2.59 versus real 3.09.
note.decides: Corrected settings use at most 5 peaks and track length at least 8, replacing 8 peaks without filtering. Track-count agreement is explicitly outside the exit criteria.

note.role: Cache measured radar power. This script reads RADIal radar arrays and labels, keeps consecutive labelled frame runs, and writes power maps with vehicle labels.
note.details: Reads radar_FFT/fft_*.npy under the fixed RADIal root. Each input has 512 range bins, 256 Doppler bins (radial motion), and 16 complex channels. Sums squared channel magnitudes, converts power to decibels, and stores float32 run_###.npy arrays. manifest.json records the dataset record, sample numbers, and vehicle range, angle, and Doppler labels. Defaults use data/measured/radial and 12 workers.
note.decides: Keeps runs of at least 16 labelled frames within one record, with index increments of 1. Floors power at 1e-12. Keeps vehicle labels with nonnegative range.

note.role: Test easier training data. This configuration claims to isolate the training data change using the earlier baseline settings and a fixed comparison budget.
note.details: Uses data/cache_easy with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences, 16 frames each at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Runs 10 epochs, explicitly 12,500 steps, with batch size 16, learning rate 0.0001, and 1,000 diffusion timesteps. Saves to checkpoints/easy_regime. Sampling uses 50 steps.
note.decides: Selects the easy-data cache and disables early stopping by omission. Phase is 1, smoothness weight 0.1, training seed 2026, and data seed 1234.

note.role: Configure the easy-data control. This configuration sets up a phase 1 run with weaker smoothness and no scheduled epoch validation.
note.details: Uses data/cache_easy with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences, 16 frames each at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Runs 10 epochs with batch size 16, learning rate 0.0001, and 1,000 diffusion timesteps. Saves to checkpoints/research_easy_control. Sampling uses 50 steps.
note.decides: Smoothness weight is 0.005. Trajectory and Doppler weights are 0.01 each. val_every_epochs is null. Phase is 1, training seed 2026, and data seed 1234.

note.role: Configure extra physics losses. This configuration adds range-Doppler and target-support settings to the easy-data control setup and saves to a separate checkpoint directory.
note.details: Uses data/cache_easy with 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences, 16 frames each at 0.5-second intervals. Model uses patch 8, stride 4, width 256, depth 8, and 8 heads. Runs 10 epochs with batch size 16, learning rate 0.0001, and 1,000 diffusion timesteps. Saves to checkpoints/research_easy_physics. Sampling uses 50 steps.
note.decides: Sets lambda_range_doppler to 0.0005, lambda_target_support to 0.003, and physics_max_t to 700. Smoothness weight is 0.005. Phase is 1 and val_every_epochs is null.

note.role: Checks whether velocity_adherence links commanded speeds to the speed positions of bright targets in synthetic radar sequences.
note.details: Builds five sequences of 16 frames, each 64 by 64 pixels. Commanded speeds are -5, -2, 1, 4 and 7. Correctly placed targets must give correlation above 0.95. Randomly placed targets must give absolute correlation below 0.9.
note.decides: Speed positions use a minimum speed of -7.987220447284345 and spacing of 0.2496006389776358, rounded to whole bins. Random seeds are 0 and 1.

note.role: Checks whether cfar_detection_stats reports more detections when synthetic radar frames contain more targets. CFAR means detecting peaks against their surrounding background.
note.details: Compares four 64 by 64 frames containing no targets with four containing three targets. Target heights are 25 before conversion to decibels. The three-target detection statistic must exceed the empty-background statistic by more than 1.0.
note.decides: Uses seed 0, absolute Gaussian noise scaled by 0.5, target positions spaced by 12 range bins and 10 speed bins, and 20*log10(f+1e-6).

note.role: Checks the simulator's complex background frames and whether their similarity between neighboring frames follows rho, the requested temporal correlation.
note.details: Requires _clutter_frames to return a nonzero complex64 tensor shaped (16,64,64). Correlation is averaged across neighboring frames in eight sequences. Rho 0.9 must beat rho 0.1 by more than 0.3 and stay within 0.15 of 0.9. Rho 0 must give absolute correlation below 0.15.
note.decides: Uses sequence length 16, nu 0.5 and seed 0. Correlation uses the real part of the conjugate inner product divided by both frame magnitudes.

note.role: Checks that ConditionEncoder turns target and environment labels into model inputs. Also checks that TemporalDiT accepts those inputs and preserves the radar sequence shape.
note.details: Four samples have five target slots, three environment values and target counts 1, 2, 5 and 3. Encoding produces (4,64). Changing unused speed and acceleration slots must leave the first encoding unchanged within 1e-6. Full condition dropout must equal null encoding. Model output is (4,4,16,16).
note.decides: Encoder width is 64. Dropout probability 1.0 removes every condition. The model uses patch 8, stride 4, depth 2 and four attention heads.

note.role: Checks cache generation, dataset loading, normalization reversal and automatic batching for RadarSequenceDataset.
note.details: Generated training items contain x shaped (16,64,64), traj shaped (5,16,2), and five speed and class slots. Six training samples must have mean within 0.3 of zero and standard deviation within 0.3 of one. Validation shares training statistics. Denormalization reverses within 1e-5. Two-item batches preserve these dimensions.
note.decides: Caches use seed 7, sequence length 16 and shard size 4. Tests generate 2 to 6 training samples and 1 to 3 validation samples.

note.role: Checks target label maps, frame and sequence detectors, and average precision, a score that rewards correctly ranked detections.
note.details: A target at (20.4,41.6) must peak at (20,42), while unused slots are ignored. Frame output is (3,64,64). Class labels produce (1,3,2,64,64), and sequence output is (2,3,16,64,64). Perfect detections score 1, a ten-bin shift scores 0, and a false detection ranked first reduces the score to 0.5.
note.decides: Detection matching radius is 2 bins. Targets use rounded positions. Both detector losses must be finite, and each target appears only in its assigned class channel.

note.role: Checks the denoising diagnostic's target masks, accumulated errors, target detection measurements and command-line parsing. An exact noise predictor checks reconstruction through evaluate_arm.
note.details: On 7 by 7 frames, target windows contain 9 center pixels or 4 corner pixels. Background masks contain 24 or 40 pixels. PairMoments must report MSE 7.5 and correlation 1 for doubled values. Exact noise gives zero prediction error, reconstruction MSE below 1e-12, no clamp changes and target recall 1.
note.decides: Guard windows cannot be smaller than target windows. A 12 dB detection threshold finds one of two target frames. Timestep parsing removes duplicates and rejects out-of-range values.

note.role: Checks analytic noise predictors and the diffusion sanity report, including forward noise addition, reconstruction and DDIM sampling, a reduced-step generation method.
note.details: GaussianOracle and TwoPointOracle must return finite tensors matching input shape. The shared report uses 4,096 samples, 200 diffusion timesteps, 50 DDIM steps and seed 314159. Forward and both sampling checks must pass. Writing sanity.json must preserve passed=true, device=cpu and a nonempty scope_limit.
note.decides: Oracle shape checks use 100 timesteps, Gaussian mean 0.25 and standard deviation 0.5, and two-point magnitude 2.0.

note.role: Checks GaussianDiffusion noise schedules, reversible prediction formulas, sampling controls and reconstruction from configuration.
note.details: The 1,000-step retained-signal schedule must decrease from above 0.99 to below 0.01. Exact noise and combined signal-noise predictions recover inputs within 1e-4. Both samplers preserve shape and finite values. Configuration defaults are eps prediction, schedule shift 1, clamp (-4,4) and terminal mode model.
note.decides: Tests cover disabled or widened clamps, opposite smoothness weights, terminal mean, schedule shift 4 dividing signal-to-noise ratio by 16, and minimum signal-to-noise weighting with gamma 5.

note.role: Checks TemporalDiT output shapes, initial zero output, spatial information sharing and trajectory condition channels. Also checks compatibility with existing attention weights and unconditional model weights.
note.details: Small models process four 16 by 16 frames with width 32, depth 2 and four heads. Temporal-only attention preserves distant spatial independence. Factorized attention shares across space, and full attention shares across space and time. Fused attention matches within 1e-5. Adding four condition channels to copied unconditional weights preserves output within 1e-6.
note.decides: Tests compare temporal-only, factorized and full attention. Full one-block influence must exceed factorized influence by 50 times. Five-layer factorized models must have fewer parameters than eight-layer baseline models.

note.role: Checks EMA, an averaged copy of model weights, and its selection and storage in training checkpoints.
note.details: With decay 0.75, a weight moving from 1 to 3 gives averaged weight 1.5. Buffers copy directly to 4, and averaged parameters require no gradients. Configured ema and automatic selection choose averaged weights, while raw chooses original weights. Two training steps must save two EMA updates in last.pt.
note.decides: Training uses four training samples, two validation samples, batch size 2, width 32, depth 1, four heads and EMA decay 0.9.

note.role: Checks experiment-arm parsing and evaluation helpers for value distributions, repeating tile boundaries and JSON-safe measurements.
note.details: Arms accept checkpoint paths plus weights and reduction overrides. Unknown or repeated options raise errors. Values [0,1,2,3] give mean and median 1.5 and sample standard deviation. Four-unit tile jumps give boundary difference 4 and interior difference 0. An undefined ratio, NaN and infinity become null.
note.decides: Tile-boundary measurement uses period 4 on an 8 by 8 image. Parsing accepts weights=ema and reduction=tile overrides.

note.role: Checks that gain_offset_db changes target brightness while preserving the distant background. Its opening comment claims target prominence exceeds RADIal by 39 dB in the specification-driven simulator.
note.details: For a steady target at 90 meters moving at 2 meters per second, a 12 dB gain offset must raise the target-row maximum by 9 to 15 dB. Background rows 0 through 9 must change by less than 1 dB in median. Explicit zero offset must exactly match the default simulator.
note.decides: Uses two-frame sequences and identical random seeds for each comparison. Target acceleration is zero and the brightness comparison uses the range row 90/3.

note.role: Checks the batch sequence generator's labels, reproducibility, target controls, background switches and argument validation.
note.details: Three eight-frame sequences produce x (3,8,64,64), traj (3,5,8,2), five speed, acceleration and class slots, and three environment values per sample. Defaults must match individual simulator calls exactly. A static 90-meter target peaks at range bin 30 and speed bin 32. Removing noise preserves later labels and lowers the floor by over 20 dB.
note.decides: Tests fixed counts, broadcast scalar inputs, per-target lists, background switches and random unspecified motion. Rejects mismatched lists, six targets, unknown classes, rho 1.5 and trajectories leaving the grid.

note.role: Checks diffusion prediction error and temporal smoothness loss, which penalizes changes between frames.
note.details: Equal predictions and references give diffusion loss zero, while comparison with zeros gives positive loss. Sixteen identical 64 by 64 frames give smoothness loss below 1e-10. Doubling sample weights doubles smoothness loss. Backpropagation must produce a nonzero input gradient.
note.decides: Uses two-sample, sixteen-frame inputs for value checks and one sample for gradient checking. Smoothness weights are one or two per sample.

note.role: Checks peak detection, track linking and sequence measurements using moving bright targets and short-lived background peaks.
note.details: A sixteen-frame moving target must be detected within one bin, persist above 0.99 and have velocity inconsistency below 1. Random jumps must increase inconsistency over tenfold. Identical distributions give marginal error below 1e-9. Removing tracks shorter than eight frames must recover one persistent target and cut inconsistency below half the unfiltered value.
note.decides: Synthetic motion advances one range bin and half a speed bin per frame. Random-jump linking uses gate 100. Background peaks last six frames. Track filters use minimum lengths 5 or 8.

note.role: Checks splitting radar frames into overlapping patches and rebuilding frames with mean, tile and Hann blending, which gives patch centers more weight.
note.details: An 8 by 8 patch with stride 4 produces 15 by 15 patches on a 64 by 64 frame. Input (2,16,64,64) becomes (2,16,225,64). Mean and Hann reconstruction match within 1e-5, while tile reconstruction is exact. Disagreeing patches produce different mean and tile outputs. Hann preserves a central peak better than mean blending.
note.decides: Patch size is 8 and stride is 4. Reconstruction modes mean, tile and hann determine how overlapping predictions contribute to each pixel.

note.role: Checks configurable radar grids and background controls while protecting the default simulator's saved outputs. Comments claim wider speed spread and multiple power measurements address differences from RADIal.
note.details: Default geometry has 64 by 64 bins, 3-meter range spacing and 189-meter maximum range. RADIal geometry has 512 by 256 bins, 0.2-meter range spacing, 102.2-meter maximum range and approximately 0.1-meter-per-second speed spacing. Separate geometry caches must preserve shapes. Seed-4321 outputs must exactly match tests/data/simulator_reference.pt.
note.decides: Defaults use one power measurement and no range gain. Eight measurements must reduce map span by over 20 dB. Near-range gain -30 dB must lower background by over 20 dB.

note.role: Checks radar settings derived from the stated RADIal specification and simulator behavior driven by those settings. Tests cover range-dependent brightness, target strength and windowing, which reduces energy leaking away from peaks.
note.details: Specification requires 512 range bins, 256 speed bins, 16 receivers, 12 transmitters and 5 frames per second. Derived bandwidth is 750 MHz, maximum range 102.2 meters and chirp interval about 76 microseconds. Doubling distance reduces target strength by 40*log10(2) dB and background strength by 30*log10(2) dB.
note.decides: Uses 16 receiver power measurements and Hamming windows. Windowing must lower tested sidelobes by over 15 dB. Cars exceed 70% of 2,000 sampled targets, averaging 8 to 12 dB target strength.

note.role: Checks splitting RADIal recordings into separate datasets and extracting consecutive frame sequences.
note.details: All 200 synthetic recordings must appear exactly once across train, validation and test, with test containing between 10% and 30% of recordings. Splitting is deterministic. Unequal recording lengths must yield at least one validation sequence and 10% to 35% test sequences. Default three-frame windows are consecutive and non-overlapping. Short runs are skipped.
note.decides: Splits account for contributed sequence counts rather than recording counts alone. Overlap requires explicit stride 1, producing starts 0, 1 and 2 for six frames with length 4.

note.role: Checks motion and target-support losses against simulated labels, and whether differentiable background detection loss responds to blurred radar maps.
note.details: Four steady, noise-free target sequences are normalized using mean 35.1472 and standard deviation 15.6529. A four-range-bin shift must worsen range_doppler_residual. Matching target support costs zero, while flat predictions cost over 1. Matching detection curves cost zero, while 5 by 5 blur costs more. Both combined and detection losses produce finite, nonzero gradients.
note.decides: Motion examples use one target, 20 dB signal-to-noise setting and seed 4. Background-loss examples use two four-frame sequences with seed 5 and blur stride 1.

note.role: Checks that generate_easy reproducibly creates finite radar sequences containing bright moving targets.
note.details: Generating two sequences with eight 64 by 64 frames and seed 11 must reproduce exactly. Every frame's maximum must exceed its nested row-and-column median by more than 20. Average absolute change between neighboring frames must exceed 0.1.
note.decides: Uses seed 11, two sequences and sequence length 8. Brightness and movement are checked through fixed minimum gaps of 20 and 0.1.

note.role: Checks sampling from trained checkpoints, cache path resolution and label-guided generation on both small radar grids and RADIal-sized scene grids.
note.details: Brief CPU training produces last.pt, whose samples must be finite and shaped (1,16,64,64). Relative data/cache resolves from the repository root. Sampling must retain v prediction, schedule shift 4 and disabled clamping. Zero guidance must match plain sampling within 1e-3. Scene sampling returns (1,2,512,256) using trajectory and presence labels.
note.decides: Checkpoint tests train for two or three steps and sample for three or five steps. Scene models use two condition channels, patch and stride 32, v prediction and terminal mean.

note.role: Checks that scene labels preserve vehicle identity across frames and that interrupted scene-cache generation resumes reproducibly.
note.details: When the first vehicle leaves, its presence becomes [true,false], while the remaining vehicle stays in its original slot with range positions 50 and 51. The engineer cache contains four training and two validation sequences of two 512 by 256 frames. Rebuilding after resetting train_progress.json to two completed sequences must reproduce the fourth sample exactly.
note.decides: Cache generation uses the engineer variant and per-sequence seeds. Packed trajectories have shape (4,MAX_VEHICLES,2,2), and presence records whether each vehicle appears in each frame.

note.role: Tests whether detector summaries recover the simulator's clutter settings. Draws radar sequences through TemporalRadarSimulator and saves selected settings to JSON.
note.details: Defaults to 16 sequences of 8 frames per draw. Searches 25 correlation and texture pairs against three true pairs and three seeds. Compares CFAR (a detector using nearby cells), raw mean, spread and correlation, and standardized moments. CFAR uses false-alarm probabilities 0.01, 0.001 and 0.0001. Output defaults to archive/codex_research/results/research_cfar_calibration.json.
note.decides: Selects the smallest mean squared feature difference after scaling by candidate spread. Optional reference gain shifts are +8, -6 and +12 dB.

note.role: Tests whether similar false detections per cell produce similar false paths across frames. Uses target-free scores from research_tail_risk and saves ordered versus shuffled path counts.
note.details: Defaults to 8 training sequences, 12 test sequences and a 1% false-alarm target. Tests six correlation and texture pairs. Test scores reshape to 8 frames of 56 by 56 cells per sequence. false_tracks counts endpoints linked across three frames. Output defaults to archive/codex_research/results/research_false_tracks.json.
note.decides: Uses the training 99th percentile by default. Links allow one cell of movement on each axis. Shuffling mixes sequences separately for each frame.

note.role: Measures background detection paths in cached RADIal sequences and compares their original order with shuffled frames. Reads manifest.json and run-numbered NumPy maps, then writes window records and summaries.
note.details: Defaults to data/measured/radial, nonoverlapping 16-frame windows and 20 permutations seeded with 0. ca_cfar_ratio divides cell power by surrounding mean power. vehicle_mask excludes all Doppler cells within eight range bins of labelled vehicles, using 0.201 metres per bin. Output defaults to archive/codex_research/results/research_radial_gate.json.
note.decides: Uses four training cells and two guard cells per side. Thresholds retain 0.1% or 1% of window cells. Paths allow one or four cells.

note.role: Measures three-frame detection paths in measured Rad-R captures against shuffled frame order. Reads an HDF5 cache and writes per-capture counts, which may include real objects.
note.details: Reads capture, frame_idx and rd_map from data/measured/radr/training_cache.h5 by default. Sorts frames within each capture and rejects nonfinite maps. run defaults to 0.5% cell occupancy and random seed 201. Reports frame count, median frame-index gap, observed occupancy and ordered versus 20 shuffled counts. Output defaults to archive/codex_research/results/research_real_track_gap.json.
note.decides: Thresholds each frame separately at its 99.5th percentile. Links permit one cell of movement on each axis. Keeps full map resolution.

note.role: Tests three ways to set thresholds for rare false detections in synthetic clutter. Its scores function also supplies research_false_tracks.
note.details: scores divides power by its 9 by 9 local average, crops four border cells and flattens results. Defaults to 6 training and 12 independent test sequences of 8 frames, with seeds 101 and 202. Tests three clutter settings at false-alarm targets 0.001 and 0.0001. Saves archive/codex_research/results/research_tail_risk.json.
note.decides: Compares empirical quantiles, a Gaussian mean-plus-spread threshold, and a generalized Pareto fit to excesses above the training 95th percentile.

note.role: Records an easy-data experiment testing whether low generated intensity variation survives removal of clutter and noise. The visible interpretation marks its mechanical verdict as inconclusive evidence, despite the stored INTRINSIC verdict.
note.details: Used 20,000 training and 2,000 validation sequences with one steady target at fixed 20 dB gain. At 12,500 steps, three sampling seeds produced mean spread 0.1805 versus real 1.0375, only 17.4% as large. Distribution error was 1.8261 versus real-to-real 0.0623. Temporal variation retained 2.6%. Detector validation failed. Supplied text ends mid-interpretation.
note.decides: Calls spread below 0.75 intrinsic and within 0.06 of real complexity-driven. Failed detector sanity invalidates target metrics. Samples use 50 steps.

note.role: Records recovered clutter settings without a reference gain shift. Compares detector summaries with raw and gain-invariant moments across nine trials.
note.details: Three true correlation and texture pairs each use seeds 11, 22 and 33. CFAR recovered both settings in eight of nine trials. Raw and gain-invariant moments recovered both in all nine. The CFAR miss selected texture 0.5 instead of 1.3 for true correlation 0.3 at seed 33.

note.role: Records clutter-setting recovery when reference brightness changes. Shows how detector summaries and two moment methods respond to gain offsets.
note.details: Offsets are +8, -6 and +12 dB for seeds 11, 22 and 33. Across nine trials, CFAR recovered both settings eight times, gain-invariant moments nine times, and raw moments once. The CFAR miss selected texture 0.5 instead of 1.3 at correlation 0.3 with +12 dB gain.

note.role: Records target-free false detection paths before and after frame shuffling. Measures whether similar cell false-alarm rates preserve temporal path counts.
note.details: Each of six clutter settings uses 32 test sequences and a 1% false-alarm target. Observed cell rates range from 0.8434% to 1.0076%. Ordered three-frame counts range from 938 to 3,480, compared with 40 to 69 after shuffling. Every setting produces substantially more ordered paths.

note.role: Records generated intensity and temporal spread for control and physics arms. Compares both arms across three seeds with a real-data reference.
note.details: Real intensity spread is 1.0193 and temporal spread is 1.0661. Control intensity spread ranges 0.3160 to 0.3315, physics 0.3188 to 0.3287. Temporal spreads remain about 0.385 to 0.392 in both. Physics distribution errors are 1.5284 to 1.5347, below control's 1.5941 to 1.6068 but far above real-to-real 0.0440.

note.role: Records measured RADIal background paths compared with permuted frame order. Provides summaries for four detection-density and movement settings, followed by window records.
note.details: Each setting covers 246 windows. At 0.1% occupancy, median ordered-to-permuted ratios are 1.000 for one-cell movement and 1.178 for four-cell movement. At 1% occupancy, ratios are 1.051 and 1.134. Ordered counts exceed permutation means in 83.7% and 93.5% of the 1% windows, respectively. Supplied window records are truncated.
note.decides: Summary ratios add one to both ordered counts and permutation means before division.

note.role: Records ordered and shuffled detection-path counts for nine measured Rad-R captures. These counts measure temporal dependence and are not labelled false tracks.
note.details: Every capture has 200 frames, median frame-index gap 3 and about 0.50024% occupancy. Eight captures exceed their shuffled mean. degrade0 has 47,807 ordered paths versus 44,214.85 shuffled. blockage2 has 46,953 versus 43,531.35. healthy is close at 48,743 versus 48,637.45. vib1 is lower at 48,199 versus 48,355.25.

note.role: Records observed synthetic false-alarm rates for Gaussian, empirical and tail-fit thresholds. Evaluates six combinations of clutter settings and requested false-alarm probability.
note.details: Each trial uses 150,528 training cells and 301,056 test cells. At a 0.1% target, Gaussian rates are 1.181% to 1.915%, empirical 0.0591% to 0.1498%, and tail-fit 0.0531% to 0.1442%. At a 0.01% target, Gaussian rates remain 0.832% to 1.189%. One tail-fit trial records zero test detections.

note.role: Sets up fine-tuning from checkpoints/pilot_pre_d0/last.pt on the reality cache. Directs checkpoints to checkpoints/pilot_ft_d0 and logs to archive/fidelity_pilot_64/logs/pilot_ft_d0.log.
note.details: Uses 200 training sequences from a 2,000-training, 800-validation cache at data/pilot/reality. Sequences have 16 frames spaced 0.5 seconds apart. Model uses patch and stride 8, width 256, eight layers, eight heads and four conditioning channels. Trains 300 epochs with batches of 32 and learning rate 0.0001. Samples with 30 steps.

note.role: Fits simulator settings to RADIal training recordings by comparing four map statistics. Writes the reference measurements, range correction, ranked candidates and best candidate to JSON.
note.details: Defaults use 150 real frames and six simulated sequences per candidate. Searches 72 combinations: four integration counts, three sigma_f values and six target-gain intervals. Output defaults to archive/first_radial_simulator/results/simulator_fit_radial.json.
